# git: alias: add amend|reword instead of git commend

Replace the old `commend` alias with two commands built on Git 2.32's `--fixup=reword:`/`--fixup=amend:` ([Git 2.33 highlights](https://github.blog/2021-08-16-highlights-from-git-2-33/)), so that any commit — not just `HEAD` — can be reworded or amended and folded back with an autosquash rebase:

```bash
$ git reword <commit>
->
$ git commit --no-edit \
    --fixup=reword:<commit>
    --trailer='Signed-off-by=...'
$ EDITOR=true git rebase -i --autosquash foo^
```

```bash
$ git amend <commit>
->
$ git commit --fixup=amend
$ git rebase -i --autosquash ...
```
